trailheads.name: Brumley Mountain Trail (parking)
trailheads.note: The lot at Hayters Gap on VA 80, capacity 10 (OSM; operator Virginia Department of Conservation and Recreation), 20 m from Raven Ridge, the gated road the Brumley Mountain Trail follows up to its footpath. VDOF's Channels State Forest page (read 2026-11-12): "The Brumley Mountain Trail to the Channels is now open." "The parking area at Channels Natural Area Preserve is limited to 10 vehicles." "Parking along Highway 80 is not permitted and violators will be ticketed."
